metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) over 8 quarters and T05 (TRL 6) over 8 quarters are plausible progressions, but T02 (TRL 5→target) with a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1) is essentially infeasible — no development time is allocated despite low TRL and high uncertainty.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 5-6) rather than the lower-TRL exploratory work expected for 기술선도, and the 3D spatial generation technology (T02) feels more opportunistic than leadership-oriented; the R&D-heavy, patent-forward posture typical of technology leadership is only partially reflected.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are squarely within the LLM/AI platform domain, showing good domain coherence; the dependency chain (T01→T05→T02) demonstrates logical architectural thinking about the competitive stack, though explicit differentiation rationale or competitor gap analysis is not evident.
evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their respective market boom windows (errors of 1.5yr, 2.75yr, and 1.75yr), with a mean error of 2.0 years; even under 기술선도 strategy which tolerates early completion, none of the technologies are completing before the boom — they are all completing late, which is the worst outcome for both strategies.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selections cover active AI/LLM patent spaces and growing markets, suggesting some awareness of convergence zones, but the allocation of highest urgency and strategic tier to T01 and T05 without clear patent-trend justification makes the convergence appear partially coincidental rather than deliberately engineered.

strengths: Strong domain coherence — all technologies are firmly within the LLM/Foundation Model/AI Platform space with no domain drift
Logical dependency chain (T01→T05→T02) reflects a well-structured architectural progression from collaboration infrastructure to inference acceleration to generative spatial output
weaknesses: Systematic late completion across all three technologies — every technology misses its market boom window by 1.5 to 2.75 years, undermining both preemption (기술선도) and ROI capture
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성) is allocated zero development time (start = end = 2030-Q1) despite being TRL 5 with high uncertainty (4.0) and low executability (2.0), making it effectively undeliverable
missing_technologies: Multi-agent orchestration framework (lower TRL, more exploratory — better fit for 기술선도 positioning)
Foundation model pre-training efficiency / parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) technologies to strengthen the leadership narrative
investment_issues: T02 is rated Strategic-adjacent (High tier) despite executability of 2.0 and uncertainty of 4.0, with zero development time allocated — investment is committed without a credible execution plan
Budget is fully exhausted (100% utilization) on only 3 technologies, leaving no reserve for timeline slippage or R&D pivots, which is especially risky given the high uncertainty scores
timing_issues: T01 completes 2028-Q1 vs boom 2026-Q3: 1.5-year late completion means missing the primary adoption wave entirely
T05 completes 2030-Q1 vs boom 2027-Q2: 2.75-year delay is the most severe timing failure, as inference acceleration is a near-term competitive battleground
T02 has identical start and end dates (2030-Q1) — no development window is planned, making execution impossible regardless of timing strategy
